reproductions.test: rejects a symlink passed as the catalogue root instead of traversing its target
reproductions.beforeFix: Failed: discovery followed the symlink and did not throw.
reproductions.afterFix: Passed: a symlinked resource root is rejected before traversal.

reproductions.test: rejects a symlink passed as an individual resource directory
reproductions.beforeFix: Failed: validateResource returned valid=true for a symlink to an external resource directory.
reproductions.afterFix: Passed: validation reports that the resource directory cannot be a symlink.

reproductions.test: rejects a symlink passed as the resource directory root
reproductions.beforeFix: Failed: generateRegistryItem followed the linked root and returned its component source.
reproductions.afterFix: Passed: generation rejects the symlinked resource root.

reproductions.test: rejects a symlink root when only the index fallback could provide source
reproductions.beforeFix: Failed: the fallback read index.tsx through the linked root because no packaged file spec entered the guarded resolver.
reproductions.afterFix: Passed: the index fallback now uses the canonical contained-file resolver and rejects the linked root.

reproductions.test: does not traverse a symlink used as the resources search root
reproductions.beforeFix: Failed: resolveResourceFromDisk returned source from the linked resources tree.
reproductions.afterFix: Passed: linked search roots are skipped and no external source is returned.
